newsitems.title: Experience Top Gun During the Battlefield 6 Free Trial
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents:
Until Aug 25, experience ultimate all-out warfare for free during the Battlefield 6 Free Trial. 

Command all fronts across our biggest all-out battleground yet, Tsuru Reef. Enter a sprawling island chain dense with luxury bungalows, tropical vegetation, and jagged cliff edges. Engage in naval combat across the surrounding ocean, or utilize land and air vehicles to take it to the max. With support for all modes, this archipelago is the ultimate theater of war. 

Experience the legendary return of Wake Island. All-out war shatters the tranquility of this vast, isolated paradise in the Pacific Ocean. Patrol and defend the shoreline, demolish bunkers with C-4, or take advantage of the offshore aircraft carrier. Maximize every move in this deceptively scenic coastal terrain first introduced in Battlefield 1942.

Choose from six modes, including Battlefield's signature all-out warfare in Conquest, where tanks, jets, and attack helicopters turn the tides of battle. Plus, enter the danger zone in Top Gun: Carrier Strike, where squads must operate at maximum effort in an adrenaline-fueled, multi-front battle to destroy the opposition’s carrier.

Download Battlefield REDSEC, squad up, and leave your mark with a legendary Only in Battlefield moment across land, sea, or air.

Requires Battlefield REDSEC on applicable platform (available separately) and all game updates. Limited time free trial. Trial time is subject to change. Internet connection, EA account, acceptance of EA User Agreement (terms.ea.com) and Privacy & Cookie Policy (privacy.ea.com) required to play. Trial can be played once per EA account.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807960/Battlefield_6/

newsitems.title: Battlefield 6 Live Now
newsitems.author: pkrebber
newsitems.contents: [p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/62KTuiWz2S2TGoo9r852zU/a43ba74922ade767fa35102beeb8e473/image15.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img]  [/p][p align="start"]Battlefield 6 kicks off a whole new era of high-intensity combat. Whether you are battling in intense infantry firefights, attacking enemies in jets, reviving teammates in the heat of battle, or driving a tank through a collapsing building, this is all-out warfare like you’ve never seen it before. Welcome to the world of Battlefield 6.[/p][p align="start"]Here’s everything you need to know before you deploy, and what to look forward to when you hit the frontlines for the first time.[/p][h2][b]World of Battlefield 6[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The year is 2027. The world is on the edge of chaos. After a high-profile assassination shocks the world, major European countries have left NATO, while the US and its allies grapple with the fallout. [/p][p align="start"]A massive private military corporation with no fear, deep pockets and the latest tech, looks to fill the power vacuum. This army is Pax Armata.[/p][p align="start"]What’s left of NATO is wounded and battered. But the remnants have formed a hardened alliance determined to put an end to this threat.[/p][p align="start"]Welcome to Battlefield 6.[/p][h2][b]Single Player Campaign[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5LbxNl2DNT1Wd3XuB3uqQT/22e60b9e8a50d665b571bbc56c1d1f3b/BF6-Global-Scale-Campaign-16x9.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6513020833333333,yPosition=0.5560185185185185"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Battlefield 6 includes a nine mission global-scale single-player Campaign following Dagger 13, an elite US Marine Raiders unit tasked at stabilizing NATO against a Coalition led by Pax Armata.[/p][p align="start"]We highly recommend new players - as well as all players interested in Battlefield 6’s lore - to play the Campaign first before jumping into Multiplayer or Portal experiences.[/p][p align="start"]Learn more about Battlefield 6’s Campaign [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/single-player-campaign"]here[/url].[/p][h2][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5ImfRla2kaT9hZxRIRzkm7/ca5ea5fe359b854e49f8fe932fcef485/BF6-Iconic-AllOut-Warfare-16x9.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.44583333333333336,yPosition=0.3731481481481482"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Following the events of the Campaign, Battlefield 6’s Multiplayer showcases NATO and PAX Artmata in an all-out, near-neverending war:[/p][p align="start"][b]Play as NATO:[/b] As key European powers withdraw from NATO, the world is left more unstable than ever before. The United States, the United Kingdom, and Egypt are here to defend what’s left, with an army of soldiers driven by duty and honor.[/p][p align="start"][b]Play as PAX Armata:[/b] This shadowy coalition is ready to capitalize on disruption, aiming to usurp the United States as the world’s leading superpower. Pax Armata is a massive private military corporation with deep pockets, the latest tech, and no government red tape. They are hellbent on using this once-in-a-generation opportunity to seize power.[/p][p align="start"]In Multiplayer, you will be placed into one of these two factions as your team. However, you will always have the choice to pick a far more important role: your class.[/p][h2][b]Choose your class[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6RGsNHcmceexVc0VgfvxQg/0f52903a1cfb4b70217610463d217152/BF6-Classes-Overview-Thumbnail-16x9.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Battlefield’s class system, encouraging you to fulfill a specific role in the fight, is back. New to the system are training options that unlock additional traits that are earned in battle, rewarding those who play the objective with an active ability to help turn the tide of war.[/p][p align="start"]Battlefield 6’s deep customization system allows players to arm themselves with any weapon for any situation, but each class shines when you take advantage of signature weapon sets that lean into your class role.[/p][p align="start"]For those who wish to play with closed weapon loadouts, the option will be easily accessible in official playlists with full XP progression available.[/p][p align="start"]Here is an overview of each class, with a dedicated guide to each class found within the full Battlefield 101 Onboarding Hub:[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1u60mihiE14HqfCph2V0Yi/5e31b502abd6c92da59f80bbed33e441/BF6-101-Assault-Class-asset1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][h3][b]ASSAULT[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]CHARGE // CONTROL[/b][/p][p align="start"]ROLE[/p][list][*][p]The ultimate frontline fighter, designed to lead the squad through enemy defenses. Dominate close-to-mid range encounters and limit the enemy's ability to fight.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE WEAPON [/p][list][*][p][b]Assault Rifle:[/b] Faster draw times with Assault Rifles. Fire sooner when exiting a sprint.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE TRAIT[/p][list][*][p][b]Mission-Focused:[/b] Faster progress with objectives, including arming and disarming M-COM explosives. Quicker cooldown for your in-combat state, allowing squadmates to deploy on you sooner.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE GADGET[/p][list][*][p][b]Adrenaline Injector:[/b] Clears and gives temporary resistance to flash and stun effects, boost sprint speed, reduces explosive damage and makes enemy footsteps more audible.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]ACTIVE ABILITY[/p][list][*][p][b]Rally Squad[/b]: You and nearby squad members gain a temporary adrenaline effect. Its effects on you can be extended with kills.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]TRAINING OPTIONS[/p][list][*][p][b]Frontliner:[/b] Experts at leading their squad into hostile territory. Locate enemy positions to launch surprise attacks and gain the upper hand.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breacher:[/b] Highly combat effective and skilled at maneuvering. Break through enemy lines with effective use of small explosives and grenade launchers.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/73B8Iw5y3rneYP7p89rYZH/e627aa5ba13dc2b75c078576f1696310/BF6-101-Engineer-Class-asset2.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][h3][b]ENGINEER[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]WRECK // REPAIR[/b][/p][p align="start"]ROLE[/p][list][*][p]The battlefield’s leading vehicle and equipment technician. Execute repairs to keep allies combat effective or strike hostile armor with force to break their attack.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE WEAPON [/p][list][*][p][b]Sub Machine Guns:[/b] Improved hip-fire control.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE TRAIT[/p][list][*][p][b]Mechanized Infantry[/b]: Take less explosive damage when near friendly vehicles and prevent them from being occupied by hostiles in the event of all passengers exiting. Repair vehicle health to keep both effects active.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE GADGET[/p][list][*][p][b]Repair Tool[/b]: A blow torch to repair friendly vehicles and equipment. Can also damage enemy assets. Extended use will temporarily overheat the tool.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]ACTIVE ABILITY[/p][list][*][p][b]Power Fix:[/b] Repair Tool fixes with 50% efficiency for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]TRAINING OPTIONS[/p][list][*][p][b]Anti-Armor:[/b] Specialists in combating enemy armor. Operate launchers more efficiently and utilize extra ammo to eliminate ground and air threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Engineer:[/b] Experts in maintaining combat equipment. Repair vehicles and gadgets more efficiently and keep them operating with maximum effect.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1528lpI2zwjU21QWKFy7ve/577e3572a9f828eb829b49c04bd3aad1/BF6-101-Support-Class-asset3.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][h3][b]SUPPORT[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]PROTECT // SUPPLY[/b][/p][p align="start"]ROLE[/p][list][*][p]The backbone of any combat unit for defense and sustained fighting. Heal and resupply friendly forces while fortifying defensive positions to keep them protected.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE WEAPON[/p][list][*][p][b]Light Machine Guns:[/b] Does not suffer sprint speed penalty with this weapon type.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE TRAIT[/p][list][*][p][b]Squad Supplies[/b]: Squad members can interact with you to gain health and ammunition.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE GADGET[/p][list][*][p][b]Supply Bag:[/b] Heals allies and resupplies weapon and gadget ammo.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]ACTIVE ABILITY[/p][list][*][p][b]Restock Abilities:[/b] Resupply and heal nearby friendly forces for 10 seconds. Reviving teammates only takes 2.5 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]TRAINING OPTIONS[/p][list][*][p][b]Combat Medic:[/b] These units are able to function as a health dispensary for allies and also regenerate health when they’re reviving teammates. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Support:[/b] These combat experts have improved weapon control from mounted positions and can provide ammo to teammates.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4qY80xjwSHbHmGRZPUQ8al/4830c3d88fb56effe04f20ea7f50224a/BF6-101-Recon-Class-asset4.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][h3][b]RECON[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]REVEAL // CONCEAL[/b][/p][p align="start"]ROLE [/p][list][*][p]The perfect intelligence and counterintelligence operative. Neutralize targets from distance or infiltrate, gathering intel, and disrupt hostiles in their path.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE WEAPON[/p][list][*][p][b]Sniper Rifles:[/b] Faster rechambering between shots, decreased scope sway and improved breath control to help stabilize aim for longer.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE TRAIT[/p][list][*][p][b]Auto-Spot:[/b] Looking at hostiles while aiming down sights will spot them, marking their position in-world and on the minimap. Time required to spot is dependent on factors such as movement and zoom level.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]SIGNATURE GADGET[/p][list][*][p][b]Motion Sensor:[/b] This gadget tracks enemy movement in its range.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]ACTIVE ABILITY[/p][list][*][p][b]UAV Overwatch:[/b] Call in UAV to a marked position for passive spotting of enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]TRAINING OPTIONS[/p][list][*][p][b]Sniper:[/b] These long-distance engagement experts have improved auto-spot speed, range, and duration. Sniper shots will highlight enemies and temporarily prevent healing while headshots will render the struck enemy unrevivable. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Pathfinder:[/b] These infiltration-focused commandos are undetectable by equipment except when they’re sprinting, highlight enemies they damage for the rest of the team, and can perform quieter takedowns. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Squad Strategies for Success[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The above is only a taste of the tactics for classes, especially when it comes to working together to fill those roles as a squad. There is also a wealth of loadout options that transcend classes, thanks to the introduction of Attachment Points and other features.[/p][p align="start"]For more information about squad tactics, click [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/squad-tactics-how-to-win-in-battlefield"]here[/url].[/p][p align="start"]For more information about weapon classes and loadout building, click [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/loadout-creation-and-weapon-classes"]here[/url].[/p][h2][b]Battlefield Maps & Modes[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4LieHXdaanIIRfI1VgiQmV/e4cf125febc87c2a7d82dd18b5a0cc61/BF6Tactical-Destruction-Tank-16x9.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.4484375,yPosition=0.4185185185185185"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The in-game tutorial will direct you towards your first Multiplayer match. Selecting your new favorite Multiplayer experience boils down to two factors: the mode and maps.[/p][h3][b]FIVE THEATERS OF WAR, NINE MAPS AND TWENTY-FIVE COMBAT ZONES[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Battlefield 6 launches with experiences across five theaters of war. Within those five theaters are nine maps, which create a combined 25 Combat Zones. A Combat Zone is a hand-crafted configuration within Battlefield 6’s maps that maximize quality under a variety of modes[b].[/b][/p][p align="start"]For more information on Combat Zones and available maps at launch, visit the [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/maps"]Maps[/url] section of our Battlefield 101 onboarding hub.[/p][h3][b]MODES - ALL-OUT WARFARE and EXPERIENCES INFUSED WITH BATTLEFIELD DNA[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Battlefield 6 Multiplayer includes eight modes at launch, with more to come in post-launch season updates and not inclusive of any Community Experiences created within Portal. These modes are a mix of iconic all-out warfare and classic Multiplayer experiences infused with Battlefield DNA.[/p][p align="start"]Click [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/modes"]here[/url] for more information for all available modes at launch.[/p][h2][b]What to expect during your first match[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2bbfttavg1Ca9voHmEiUkI/993c1ba33c82de8f8bede201ee5eea65/BF6_Screenshot_09_Support_1920x1080.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.45729166666666665,yPosition=0.41388888888888886"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The Initiation modes - for example: Breakthrough Initiation, available at launch - should be every new recruit’s first step into ultimate all-out war. Initiation modes provide the same level of combat with the same level of intensity, all set in a learning environment where new players can cut their teeth alongside Bots[/p][p align="start"]After each match across all Multiplayer modes, you will earn experience towards your overall player rank, as well as towards individual weapon masteries. A report on ranking up in Battlefield, including details on every unlock from Ranks 1 through 50, can be found [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/progression-in-battlefield-6"]here[/url].[/p][p align="start"]Completely new to Battlefield or the FPS space? We got you covered - click [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/new-player-guide-to-battlefield-6"]here [/url]for our more detailed new player guide.[/p][h2][b]Portal[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5aWqonJiQ4bpRwbTNdFA0v/a78cd3b73a544d29f47836dd5c88b817/BF6-Portal-Action-Logo-16x9.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5255208333333333,yPosition=0.42407407407407405"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Battlefield Portal is a massive sandbox where creators and players can push Battlefield to the limit. Take unprecedented control of your environment by moving, scaling, and duplicating objects. Create a completely unique game mode using NPC scripting and a customizable UI. Legendary Battlefield experiences are waiting to be created—show ‘em what you’re made of.[/p][p align="start"]Portal is the platform for an unfathomable amount of experiences to be created by our community, some of which offer full experience progression. The most popular and creative Portal experiences will be featured by our developers at and after launch, adding a taste of our community’s rising creators’ best work to our developer-created Multiplayer experiences. [/p][p align="start"]We have three distinct guides on Portal: one guide is for those looking to play this mode, the second for designers who are just getting started, and the last one for more advanced creators.[/p][p align="start"]Click [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/portal-101-introduction-to-battlefield-portal"]Here [/url]for the Portal 101 Guide (Playing and Hosting Experiences)[/p][p align="start"]Click [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/portal-101-verified-experiences"]Here [/url]for the Portal 101 Guide (Basic Creator, Battlefield Portal Builder and Verified Modes)[/p][p align="start"]Click [url="https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news/portal-101-advanced-creations"]Here [/url]for the Portal 101 Guide (Advanced Creator, Portal SDK Tool and Custom Portal Experiences)[/p][h2][b]What Else is New in Battlefield 6[/b][/h2][p align="start"]There’s so much to look forward to – most of it we’ll leave for you to discover, but here’s what we’re most excited about.[/p][p align="start"][b]TACTICAL DESTRUCTION[/b]: As one of Battlefield’s most defining features, it was important for the team to figure out how to elevate the art of Destruction – both visually and as a game mechanic.[/p][p align="start"]The answer is Tactical Destruction. In Battlefield 6, you will have more options to transform the environment to your advantage. Here’s some examples of what you can do with Tactical Destruction:[/p][list][*][p]A wall blocking your way? Knock it down with a sledgehammer or blow it to pieces with C4.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy squad firing on you from above? Take out the floor beneath them with a rocket and send them plummeting to their doom (or bring the roof down on their heads).[/p][/*][*][p]Drive your tank through whole buildings to create shortcuts for the rest of the team or devastate enemy positions.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The visual bar for Destruction has also been raised.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/68O4aGRxCjiwKgmRon7mQ/39c817a3b7b3c4e85f5ea15087ece6a0/BF6-101-asset5.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]KINESTHETIC COMBAT SYSTEM:[/b] Battlefield’s new Kinesthetic Combat System is designed to give you more control over your mobility and the tactical options during the heat of battle. This includes actions to help optimize gunplay depending on the situation. These are all new options available for the first time in Battlefield.[/p][list][*][p][b]Drag and Revive[/b] lets you drag a squadmate out of the firefight, while reviving them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Peek and Lean[/b] lets you peek around corners to spy on the enemy without being exposed, utilizing this awareness to help plan strategies and get the drop on your opponents.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Rolls[/b] give you a new maneuvering ability to limit fall damage and increase your chance of dodging enemy fire.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mounting Weapons[/b] on cover allows you to steady your aim, decreasing recoil. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Hitch a Ride[/b] is a feature that expands how many players you can have on your vehicle beyond the available seats.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]As part of the Kinesthetic Combat System, reliable recoil patterns and well-defined weapon ranges help players learn and react in real-time.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6zYNdTt4ZCxdtvKUq8S0hS/48c2b61855811a73590ec6b0ca338a01/GLA_REV_Screenshot_21_DeployableShield_1920x1080.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.3953125,yPosition=0.44212962962962965"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]This is Your War - Jump into Battlefield Today[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/3SHeMKw7tL6lHyERFMEaYi/19227b85c5c2586b3cfb56068abd98b8/BF6-Phantom-Edition-Items-Beautyshot.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.28567708333333336,yPosition=0.4388888888888889"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The ultimate all-out war is here - rally the squad and join the fight today. [/p]

newsitems.title: Get Ready for Battlefield 6 - Launch Times, Secure Boot and PC Specs
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents: [h3][b]It’s almost time for all-out warfare.[/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="pimi4rOY1aE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Battlefield 6 launches around the world on October 10, 2025 at 8 a.m. PT (5 p.m. CET). All regions will be able to access the game at the same time worldwide:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45712411/7bd2aa04a6369a692fb8126911daf488f7969c56.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prior to Battlefield 6’s worldwide launch, Battlefield Studios will deploy a patch update that is required to play the game. Unless you have auto-updates enabled on your platform (by default), make sure you download that patch manually for a smooth launch day experience. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]PC Intel - Secure Boot Instructions[/b][/h2][p][b]In order to play Battlefield 6 on PC, you must enable Secure Boot. [/b]This necessary security feature allows EA’s Javelin Anticheat to detect, remove and deter cheaters. You can check whether or not Secure Boot is enabled on your computer by checking its System Information menu; simply perform a general search or enter “msinfo32” in your run command window to see this menu.[/p][p][/p][p]Specific information, including links out to your computer or motherboard manufacturer’s website for exact secure boot instructions, can be found on this EA Help article here.[/p][p] [/p][previewyoutube="nMBBXqu0OLE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]A Reminder on PC Specifications[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45712411/9774762c096741f7e7147dcde71dc6fa5aeda524.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our PC Specifications list is in no way comprehensive; we know there are hundreds of graphical cards and thousands of combinations they have with various processors. With that in mind, these specifications are designed to showcase the minimal viable build for seven in-game graphic pre-sets. [/p][p][/p][p]We highly recommend using your GPU manufacturer’s optimization software to fit your specific PC build, or venturing into the in-game Settings to fine tune everything to your personal best experience. Unless otherwise specified on official Battlefield communication channels, such as our verified social media accounts or , we also advise you to have the latest drivers installed before launching the game. [/p][p][/p][p][i]The Minimum Required Specifications is the absolute recommendation for the most basic optimized experience of Battlefield 6[/i]. Any hardware upgrades made from this base configuration can result in better graphics or framerate.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Across all specifications to run Battlefield 6, the following security features are required:[/b][/i][/p][list][*][p][i][b]TPM 2.0 Enabled[/b][/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]User Secured Boot Enabled[/b][/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]HVCI Capable[/b][/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]VBS Capable[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Minimum Required Specifications[/h3][p][b]Graphic Settings (In-game): [/b]1080p @ 30 FPS, Low Settings[/p][p][b]Upscaler: [/b]Native[/p][p][b]GPU: [/b]Nvidia RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT / Intel Arc A380[/p][p][b]Video Memory: [/b]6GB[/p][p][b]CPU: [/b]Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600[/p][p][b]RAM: [/b]16GB (Dual channel 2133mhz)[/p][p][b]OS (Operating System): [/b]Windows 10 (Enabling Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling is Recommended)[/p][p][b]DirectX: [/b]DirectX12[/p][p][b]Storage (Estimated Disk Space Required at Launch): [/b]55GB HDD[/p][p][/p][h3]Recommended Specifications[/h3][p][b]Graphic Settings: [/b]1440p @ 60FPS, High Settings / 1080p @ 80FPS+,[/p][p]Low Settings[/p][p][b]Upscaler: [/b]Native[/p][p][b]GPU: [/b]NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT / Intel Arc B580[/p][p][b]Video Memory: [/b]8GB[/p][p][b]CPU: [/b]Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X[/p][p][b]RAM: [/b]16GB (Dual channel 3200mhz)[/p][p][b]OS: [/b]Windows 11 64-bit[/p][p][b]DirectX: [/b]DirectX12[/p][p][b]Storage: [/b]90GB SSD[/p][p][/p][h3]Ultra Specifications[/h3][p][i]We have made one significant change to our recommended Ultra PC Specs since our last news post, specifically for Ultra Performance. [/i] [/p][p][i]For the ideal Ultra Performance experience of having 144 FPS (frames per second) at 1440p, the recommended settings have been adjusted from high to medium, in order to help maintain the most consistent performance for high FPS gameplay on the recommended hardware.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Graphic Settings: [/b]2160p(4k) @ 60fps, Ultra Settings / 1440p @ 144fps, Medium Settings[/p][p][b]Upscaler: [/b]Native[/p][p][b]GPU: [/b]NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 / AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX[/p][p][b]Video Memory: [/b]16GB[/p][p][b]CPU: [/b]Intel Core i9-12900 / AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D[/p][p][b]RAM: [/b]32GB (Dual channel 4800mhz)[/p][p][b]OS: [/b]Windows 11 64-bit[/p][p][b]DirectX: [/b]DirectX12[/p][p][b]Storage: [/b]90GB SSD [/p][p] [/p][h3]Ultra+ Specifications[/h3][p][b]Graphic Settings:[/b] 4k @ 144fps, High Settings / 4k @ 240fps+, Ultra Settings[/p][p][b]Upscaler: [/b]DLSS Super Resolution / DLSS Super Resolution Multiframe Generation[/p][p][b]GPU: [/b]NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080[/p][p][b]Video Memory: [/b]16GB[/p][p][b]CPU: [/b]Intel Core 9 Ultra 285k / AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D[/p][p][b]RAM: [/b]32GB (Dual channel 4800mhz)[/p][p][b]OS: [/b]Windows 11 64-bit[/p][p][b]DirectX: [/b]DirectX12[/p][p][b]Storage: [/b]90GB SSD[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Battlefield 101 - Free Game Guide, Available October 10[/b][/h2][p]Accompanying Battlefield 6 at launch, a complete overhaul of our Open Beta Battlefield 101 “Onboarding Hub” will be available on October 10. [/p][p] This official knowledge base includes concise articles ranging from Class breakdowns and Portal walkthroughs, to tips and tricks for new players and veterans alike. Because the ultimate guide to success is learning from your in-game experience, Battlefield 101 gives you the tools needed to get into the game and play, leaving the road to mastery in your hands. [/p][p][/p][p]In addition to Battlefield 101, expect regular “SITREP” guides on the EA website, which are detailed feature breakdowns of maps, modes and more. For example, our first “SITREP” overview will be on the brand-new Multiplayer mode Escalation.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]You Still Have Time to Earn Pre-Purchase Rewards[/b][/h2][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45712411/f978e984c91084fb103aa0be2c97debf1c8ab0c1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]October 10 is almost here; lock and load for launch with exclusive bonuses for pre-purchasing the game*.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45712411/3dd2dd0c5218c702e149c3450f584f9b8e2d5bf4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-purchase the Battlefield 6: Phantom Edition and get the BF Pro Token, Phantom Squad Soldier Skins, Weapon Packages, Deluxe XP Boost, and more, in addition to the full game download of Battlefield 6. Pre-purchases of both the Phantom Edition and the Standard Edition also include the Tombstone Pack, which contains a Soldier Skin and a Tombstone XP Boost Set. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807960/Battlefield_6/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] *Conditions & restrictions apply. See  for details.  Offer ends Oct 9, 2025[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: THE POWER OF PC MEETS THE POTENTIAL OF PORTAL
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents: [p]Battlefield 6 brings the best PC experience in the history of the franchise offering the widest array of features and customization options ever supported. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nMBBXqu0OLE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Here’s what you can expect at Launch:   [/p][p][/p][p][b]PC SPECS MIN/MAX/ULTRA/ULTRA+[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40697820/eee9f0d94077034f77fbdde8a61186aeb67765ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]4K GRAPHICS + UNCAPPED FRAME RATE* [/b][/p][list][*][p]4k visuals with uncapped framerates create one of the most fluid, high performance First Person Shooter experiences on the market.   [/p][/*][/list][p][b]PROTECTED BY JAVELIN ANTI-CHEAT [/b][/p][list][*][p]Our Anticheat system has unique modifications designed to safeguard against cheats and hacks specific to the FPS space. Javelin has been built from the ground up by a team of veteran engineers and analysts focused on studying cheating problems for each specific game under EA’s umbrella and designing unique features to solve those issues. [/p][/*][*][p]It is designed solely to protect against cheats within and outside of kernel mode.[/p][/*][*][p]For guidance about Secure Boot, [u][url="https://help.ea.com/help/pc/secure-boot/"]head over to our EA Help article[/url][/u].[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]ULTRAWIDE MONITOR SUPPORT[/b][/p][list][*][p]Catch every enemy flank with a full view of the battlefield, now with Ultrawide (21:9) and Super Ultrawide (32:9) monitor support.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]600+ CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS[/b] [/p][list][*][p]From HDR and HUD Scaling, to Camera Settings and Streamer mode, Battlefield 6 comes with the largest suite of customization options we’ve ever had in the Franchise. Visit our [u][url="http://ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/faq#pc-faq"]FAQ [/url][/u]for more info.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]HARDWARE FEATURE SUPPORT: [/b][/p][list][*][p]We support a suite of tech that offers upscaling, Frame Generation, Anti-Aliasing, and Latency reduction (Intel XeSS and AMD FSR)[/p][/*][*][p]With the launch of the official PC system requirements, Nvidia confirms [i]Battlefield 6[/i] will launch with support for DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, DLSS Frame Generation, DLSS Super Resolution, DLAA, and NVIDIA Reflex. Using these technologies, all GeForce RTX gamers can accelerate and enhance their experience, making gameplay smoother and more responsive.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]PLAY ON STEAM DAY 1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Battlefield 6 Steam Native and will not require the EA app.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]PORTAL [/b][/h2][p][b]REDRAW THE LINES OF BATTLE.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45712411/2823be3bf92ebdce5d6226a43ad0ca5cd2e04381.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Battlefield Portal is a massive sandbox where creators and players can push Battlefield to the limit. Take unprecedented control of your environment by moving, scaling, and duplicating objects. Create a completely unique game mode using NPC scripting and a customizable UI. Legendary Battlefield experiences are waiting to be created—show ‘em what you’re made of.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]THINK IT, CREATE IT, PLAY IT:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The unique experiences created are called “Community Experiences” - Players can recreate classic game modes such as horde mode, or create innovative experiences, like a top-down 2D shooter. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]POWERFUL CREATOR TOOLS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Includes Spatial Editing (map/geo editing), as well as AI Scripting to customize the behavior of AI combatants. The Portal Builder Tool also supports Custom UI scripting for building fully bespoke user interfaces.    [/p][/*][/list][p][b]BATTLEFIELD YOUR WAY:[/b][/p][list][*][p]With generous mutator and rule-set options, you can use our web creator Portal tool to experience Battlefield the way you want: Hardcore Mode, Closed Weapon Loadouts–the sky’s the limit. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45712411/63ebb33d601c69436d535d508aadd8974de265e8.png"][/img] [/p][p][b]FULL PROGRESSION:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players earn full XP Progression when playing Verified Community Experiences in Portal. These use existing Battlefield 6 mode templates such as Conquest, Rush, and Breakthrough, while allowing the creator to modify a wide-range of mutators to make the experience uniquely theirs.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]EASY TO DISCOVER:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players will have a wide array of options to filter the experiences they wish to see within the in-game server browser and experience library. Some select experiences can be featured directly on the home screen, making these experiences easier to find and join than ever. [/p][/*][*][p]Included with game purchase, players will also have the ability to make their hosted servers persistent, so it's always listed in the browser for easy access.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45712411/2dd162b7988d3c271218812fd1ab9ca2f5d89b81.png"][/img][/p][p][b]POST LAUNCH SUPPORT: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Creation and innovation doesn’t stop at launch. Post-launch support will include modes, maps, weapons, and other features as they are added to the game, giving creators and players evergrowing ways to expand their Battlefield experience.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]*Requires a compatible 4K display and supporting hardware. Visual quality may vary. [/p][p]**Some features require a PC with the appropriate hardware installed. Please refer to our PC Specs Graphic for additional details.  [/p][p]  [/p]
